subject: health
concept: Understanding when and how to call for emergency help
source_inspiration: original content, general age-appropriate emergency awareness — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student practices stating their name, location, and the nature of an emergency in a role-play call
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a scenario to whether it's a true emergency requiring emergency services
exercise.abstract: Student explains what information is important to share when calling for emergency help

misconception_flags: cannot distinguish a genuine emergency from a situation that doesn't require emergency services

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
